details:
Our biggest update yet! 
1. Track this week, month or year, and it starts over on its own. 
2. Four Home layouts: List, Cards, Stamps and Compact. 
3. Lock Screen widgets, plus new large Birthday Calendar, Countdown Calendar and Longest Count Ups widgets. 
4. A widget gallery inside the app, showing your own dates. 
5. 12 progress styles for your events and widgets, and you can try them all free for 24 hours. 
6. Reminders are now free, and birthday reminders repeat every year. Premium adds several reminders per event at the time you choose. 
7. Share any date as an image, or share a recap of your year. 
8. Insights rebuilt around your time. 
9. Widget fonts, photo backgrounds and accent colors (Premium). 
10. On iPad, your list sits beside the detail, and adding a date opens a full page with a live preview. 
11. Now in German, Spanish and French. 
12. Redesigned onboarding, Insights, Notes and Settings, with better accessibility. 
 There were many more improvements and bug fixes, including blank widgets and birthdays on the day itself. Hope you enjoy it!

Here's some improvements that was made in this version. 
1. new count up widget with milestones, 
2. fixed widgets color adaptation to dark mode, 
3. slightly updated the charts design, 
4. added in-app review option. 
 There was a few more improvements and bug fixes, hope you enjoy the app!

Focused on improving the app and bug fixes. 
1. Fixed home page scrolling bug, 
2. updated homepage colors to accomodate non system colors, 
3. updated the countdown bars to show in real time, 
4. fixed the bug on ipad that dismissed the page when the + icon was pressed, 
5. Added tips for firt time users on how to use the app. 
 There was a few more improvements and bug fixes

Made some app improvements and added some new exciting features. 
1. Birthday now filters correctly, 
2. header is now static 
3. Small widget now has only one variation: birthday 
4. Added premium features 
- app customization: now able to change app's background color 
- widgets customization: change background & chart style 
-Notifications: you can now toggle notifications on/off 
 Aside from these changes, There was a few more improvements and bug fixes

added feature to track birthdays, added option to add a photo to notes, birthdays now display age in the view and widget. made it an option to add the hour to the date. added widgets for the birthdays as well as a progress bar on them. redesigned widgets.
Added widgets, added entry edit, restart, and delete options, and fixed bugs
